title: Packard
summary: Packard (formerly the Packard Motor Car Company) was an American luxury automobile company located in Detroit, Michigan. One of the "Three Ps" – alongside Peerless Motor Company and Pierce-Arrow – the company was known for building high-quality luxury automobiles before World War II. A Packard was a prestigious vehicle, and surviving examples are often found in museums and automobile collections.
